detailed_descriptions.en: A WASTELAND TO REVIVE The "Toxicity" DLC takes you to a unknown planet heavily corrupted by past industrial activity. You must restore its majesty using new tools and machinery. Alone or with friends, explore this wasteland, uncover its secrets and help it revive! PLAY WITH FRIENDS Only one copy of the DLC is required to play multiplayer co-op and enjoy this new content with friends. EXPLORE A NEW WORLD Embark on an adventure taking place on a new planet slighty smaller than Planet Prime . Discover many new biomes alongside mysterious fungal flora and traces of human activity. UNVEIL LORE Who once occupied this planet? Set foot on this new world and grasp new chunks of lore surrounding Sentinel Corp and the Planet Crafter Program . KEEP ON BUILDING! Make yourself at home, build new machines and settle your dream exploration-base! To play the Toxicity DLC, you can either travel to this planet via the game's interplanetary system once it is unlocked or start afresh, creating a new separate save (and select the planet "TOXICITY").

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
A WASTELAND TO REVIVE

The "Toxicity" DLC takes you to a unknown planet heavily corrupted by past industrial activity. You must restore its majesty using new tools and machinery. Alone or with friends, explore this wasteland, uncover its secrets and help it revive!

PLAY WITH FRIENDS

Only one copy of the DLC is required to play multiplayer co-op and enjoy this new content with friends.

EXPLORE A NEW WORLD

Embark on an adventure taking place on a new planet slighty smaller than Planet Prime. Discover many new biomes alongside mysterious fungal flora and traces of human activity.

UNVEIL LORE

Who once occupied this planet? Set foot on this new world and grasp new chunks of lore surrounding Sentinel Corp and the Planet Crafter Program.

KEEP ON BUILDING!

Make yourself at home, build new machines and settle your dream exploration-base!

To play the Toxicity DLC, you can either travel to this planet via the game's interplanetary system once it is unlocked or start afresh, creating a new separate save (and select the planet "TOXICITY").
